summary: The app is implemented; iteration 2 added plan audit and habit friction insight; RALPH-20 added full browser E2E outcome coverage, ARIA state checks, isolated browser contexts, and refreshed evidence. The standards/meta-meta audit added a fourth governed bead, corrected stale quality-gate residual risk, and generated audit records. Certification-readiness hardening added contrast and labeling fixes plus executable accessibility evidence. UX/reliability QA certification added mobile shell compaction, explicit state controls, local-state normalization, corrupted-state tests, and an internal QA certificate. Material UI standards conformance added Google Material 3 / Material 3 Expressive tokenization, role colors, shape, motion, static/accessibility enforcement, refreshed WYSIWYG evidence, and an internal Material conformance certificate. Human review portal readiness added a static dashboard, machine index, Mermaid diagram atlas, role-based onboarding paths, portal validators, meta-meta skill updates, and an internal portal readiness certificate. Hawkeye and the execution kernel pass. The artifact-catalog coverage audit passes only as truthful gap disclosure: full standalone catalog saturation fails with 14 missing catalog artifacts.
required_unblock: None for the bounded static app slice. Full artifact saturation is not complete: the 63-item catalog matrix lists 14 missing standalone artifacts plus combined and partial coverage. Future backend, sync, mobile, hosting, auth, production, external QA/certification, regulated-data work, native Material implementation, hosted documentation portal, additional UI/documentation standards scope, or full artifact saturation requires a new change-controlled bead.
